prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters with simple rounded cartoon bodies, flat colour and black outlines, but every face is painted with startling real skin: pores, stubble, wrinkles, wet tired eyes, real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, no feature exaggerated. Every colour is laid on in thick visible oil brushstrokes. Night, a secret 1930s basement full of blank green paper money with no printing under emerald lamps, hot as an oven: gangsters in pinstripe trousers and sweat-soaked vests sprawl in armchairs, fanning themselves with notes, ice melting in their champagne buckets, collars open, shining with sweat; a fat copper heating pipe along the wall glows orange-hot. One lies on a pile of money with a damp cloth on his head. Most of the frame warm shadow; the brightest values are the glowing pipe and the emerald lamps on wet skin. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
